description: Procedures for identification, collection, and preservation of evidence are not established.
applicability: Applies when an organization lacks documented procedures for identifying, collecting, acquiring, and preserving evidence related to information security incidents in a manner that maintains evidentiary integrity for potential legal, regulatory, or disciplinary proceedings.

metadata.detection_notes: Review evidence handling procedures, verify chain of custody documentation, check for forensic capabilities and tools, assess evidence preservation methods, examine legal admissibility requirements compliance, verify personnel training in evidence collection.
